derived_features.availability: Computed only from funding_time strictly before decision_time.
derived_features.definition: Within the trailing funding_lookback_hours, sum funding_rate with an exponential half-life and divide by the deterministic eight-hour slot normalizer.
derived_features.missing_rule: Exclude the symbol when event count is below minimum_funding_events or the latest event exceeds maximum_funding_age_hours; never impute cross-sectionally or forward-fill.
derived_features.purpose: Measure relative directional crowding and expected relative carry per eight-hour interval.

derived_features.availability: Computed from the same strictly past funding window.
derived_features.definition: Absolute exponentially weighted signed funding mass divided by exponentially weighted absolute funding mass plus a frozen floor.
derived_features.purpose: Increase conviction when crowding has a persistent sign without changing its direction.

derived_features.availability: The newest input candle opens exactly eight hours before decision_time and is closed at decision_time.
derived_features.definition: Log close-to-close move over confirmation_bars divided by trailing RMS eight-hour log returns and square-root horizon scaling.
derived_features.missing_rule: Exclude the symbol unless volatility_bars plus one contiguous eight-hour closes end exactly at decision_time minus eight hours; do not compress gaps.
derived_features.purpose: Confirm that price has begun moving against the crowded funding side.

derived_features.availability: Computed at the decision boundary after symbol-level eligibility checks.
derived_features.definition: Average-tie cross-sectional ranks map funding pressure and price confirmation independently to [-1, 1]. For the opposite-of-crowding direction, take the smaller of the crowding-threshold margin and aligned-confirmation-threshold margin, add the fixed 2.0 pass-boundary offset, and apply the desired direction as sign. The resulting finite signed dictionary crosses the A5 identity boundary once. Absolute returned score at least 2.0 passes both thresholds; its magnitude ranks and proportionally sizes the selected side subject to the frozen cap.
derived_features.missing_rule: Request an explicit flat book if the valid cross-section or either sleeve lacks frozen minimum breadth.
derived_features.purpose: Produce the exact causal long-desirability score used after capture for filtering, side selection, ordering, and capped proportional allocation.
